hints.title: Build from smaller amounts
hints.body: If you know the best answer for `amount - coin`, you can extend it with one coin.

hints.title: State
hints.body: Let `dp[x]` be the fewest coins that make exactly `x`.

hints.title: Transition
hints.body: For every coin not larger than `x`, `dp[x] = min(dp[x], dp[x - coin] + 1)`.
